newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers little changed amid few enquirie.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers little changed amid few enquirie.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes hovered around their recent levels despite falling fuel oil swaps and enquiries ahead of the weekend holiday, traders said.
"Singapore prices are too high compared with other ports and many shipowners are just shopping around without much interest," said one trader.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted $105/$106 and the 380-cst was at $99/$100. MDO and gas oil were quoted at about $193/$195 and $203/$205 respectively.
